cases.name: selected-file-clipped
cases.cause: After native 150% zoom and resize the selected data.json button starts beyond the visible tab strip. Product auto-reveal fixes it without a click or focus workaround.

cases.name: fixture-paste-before-editor-ready
cases.cause: The harness pasted before the reopened Monaco editor displayed its original content. Added the established actual path/content readiness check; the 10-second bridge deadline and exact draft assertion remain.

cases.name: raw-filesystem-diagnostic-shown
cases.cause: An exact owned rename EIO reaches the save-and-close error toast verbatim. Project writes now wrap coded filesystem errors with a recovery message and preserve the diagnostic cause in the main process; UI translation, byte preservation, staging cleanup and retry are checked.
